svg.data-poe: IEEE 802.3af/802.3at on all 48 RJ45 ports, up to 30 W per port, 820 W system budget
svg.data-optics-sfp-plus: 10G SFP+ SR/LR/ER/ZR (datasheet Compatible Transceivers; 80 km / 1G-10G per HIG Port Overview)
svg.data-usb: 1 x USB 1.0 Type-A port (datasheet wording; HIG cabling says USB 2.0 - see gaps)
svg.data-emc: FCC Part 15 Subpart B Class A; ICES-003 Class A; EN 55032 Class A; EN 300 386; EN 55035

circle.data-description: HIG Fan FRU LED table - Off (main board 3.3V power fail, or fan not present), Solid Green (fan present and interrupt de-assert), Blinking Yellow (fan present but interrupt assert). The table's Blinking Green and Solid Yellow rows read N/A and are deliberately not modelled

HIG Fan FRU LED table - Off (main board 3.3V power fail, or fan not present), Solid Green (fan present and interrupt de-assert), Blinking Yellow (fan present but interrupt assert). The table's Blinking Green and Solid Yellow rows read N/A and are deliberately not modelled

circle.data-states: off ok standby critical input-lost warning
circle.data-description: HIG PSU FRU LED table - Off (no input power to all power supplies), Green (output ON and OK), Blinking Green (standby state input power present; the table's second Blinking Green row, firmware updating in boot-loader mode, is visually identical and shares this state), Yellow (critical event causing shutdown - failure, over current, short circuit, over voltage, fan failure, over temperature), Blinking Yellow (AC cord unplugged or AC lost with the second supply still fed), Blinking between Green and Yellow (warning events where the supply keeps operating - high temp, high power, high current, slow fan)

circle.data-states: off ok standby critical input-lost warning
